vibe_rationale: Curated, multi-venue, maker-led design and craft week with more than 130 events, though the design scene is narrower and government-led.
fit_notes: Canberra's closest SURPLUS analogue in format, with an adult creative-class audience suited to a considered installation or workshop. The health link is indirect, so the route is design-led wellbeing or a maker workshop, and the sponsors page and around 20 named partners show the slots are open.
